annotations.title: Get an Israeli rules parameter at a date

description: One parameter of the verified rules dataset by its dotted id (e.g. "tax.income.brackets.monthly", "credit_points.value.monthly", "btl.employee.rates", "labor.minimum_wage.monthly", "vat.rate"): the value in force on the date, its effective date, status (verified / provisional / outside coverage), full history and official source URLs.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Outside the verified coverage the tool answers with an error, never a guess.

verbose.description: Full history with every value and source (default: compact history)

name: get_parameter
title: Get an Israeli rules parameter at a date
